page.layout: One printed page. Running head "INDEX" centred at top. Below it two columns of index entries, left column then right column. Below the columns a woodcut ornament (no text). No margin notes.

main_text.l: 2. Ascensio Christi in coelos, postquam benedixisset discipulis suis: Ministerii Euangelici summa 1186. benedictio efficax in sacro ministerio: Ascensionis speciales circunstantiae 1187
3. Summus gradus glorificationis Christi, qui sedit ad dexteram Patris: quid sit illa sessio, & eiusdem efficacia 1188
4. Discipuli adorato Christo oculos in coelum intendunt: qualis illa adoratio fuerit: quibus oculis intueri velit Christus 1189
5. Angeli duo Christo regi suo seruientes Apostolos docent, & reprehendunt 1190. eosdem consolantur 1191

6. Discipuli reuertuntur Ierosolymam cum gaudio, & unde gaudium istud 1191. tanti gaudii causa: perseuerantia in professione fidei unde: discipuli promissionis Christi complementum expectant 1192. conueniunt in templo 1193
7. Summa Actorum Apostolicorum: Pastorum Ecclesiae officium 1193. Apostolorum egressio miraculosa, & felix successus, seu Euangelicae praedicationis Apostolorum tempore mirabilis efficacia 1194

page.notes: Index entries are set in two columns; the left column opens with a catchline-like fragment "refellit 1185" which is a continuation. Page numbers are at the right of each entry as printed (in Roman-style lowercase numerals such as 1185 and 1194). The woodcut ornament below the columns contains no text.
